text: {"label": "Varieties, History, and Theory of Behaviorism","definition": "Conceptual and historical scholarship on the diverse forms of behaviorism, including interbehavioral, theoretical, methodological, and culturo-behavioral views, and on their philosophy of science and relation to psychology.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Surveys many behaviorisms and their history broadly, not radical behaviorism's foundations specifically, interpretations of creativity and complex behavior, or evolutionary theories of behavior dynamics."}
